quote: Midterm Exam 25 / Final Exam 25 / Assignment 25 / Project 20 -- "**Total: 95**"
message: Assessment weights sum to 95 (25 + 25 + 25 + 20 = 95), not 100. The document itself states 'Total: 95', confirming a shortfall of 5 points against the required 100.
